description:
The Airtasker app brings Customers and Taskers together, making it easier to get things done or find your next job, all within ChatGPT. From cleaning, removals and furniture assembly to gardening, deliveries and odd jobs - if you need a hand, there’s a Tasker for that.

Connect to access the Airtasker experience in ChatGPT. Customers can describe what they need, post a task, review incoming offers from local Taskers and assign the right person, all without leaving the conversation. Taskers can use the Airtasker ChatGPT App to browse available tasks in their area, make offers on the go and get help crafting offers that are clear, professional and more likely to win the job.
